BiblicalUsage: The Bible's word here is tsachtsâchâh, meaning a dry place, i.e. desert. It appears once, in Isaiah 58:11.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is simple: tsachtsâchâh matters because God said it, and God wastes no words.
